name: GitFerry MCP
description: Packs unpushed commits, worktree changes, and untracked files into one portable bundle, inspects a bundle, and applies it to another repository for air-gapped transfer. pack_changes and inspect_bundle read a repository or validate a bundle and inherit Guard policy; apply_bundle replays commits and applies patches into a target repository and requires review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Keep apply_bundle on Review: it replays commits and applies patches into the target repository. Inspect the bundle first with inspect_bundle and review its file list and diffs before applying.
Use pack_changes and inspect_bundle for read-only packing and validation; neither modifies an existing repository's tracked history.
